question: The Constitution (87th Amendment) Act, 2003 provided for the delimitation of the constituencies on the basis of the census of __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2001**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Constitution (87th Amendment) Act, 2003**, is an amendment to the Constitution of India that altered the 1950 national census as the basis for the delimitation of constituencies of Lok Sabha and state legislative assemblies.
 
• This amendment changed the original freeze based on the 1971 census until the **2001 census** enforced by the 42nd amendment in 1976 due to concerns around unequal population growth rates among different states.
 
• Thus, it provides for the** readjustment and rationalization of parliamentary and assembly constituencies based on the 2001 census**.
